routing.reusableRuntime: PrimeRuntime.generate(messages:options:) and PrimeRuntimeLoader in prime-runtime; backend adapters MLXPrimeRuntime and CoreMLPrimeRuntime load declared model bundles and use their compatible tokenizers.
routing.neuralKitRole: PrimeRuntimeSession owns a loaded runtime; PrimeAskBrain wraps session loading and proposal. NeuralKit is already a separate Swift package rather than the PMHNP app target.
routing.remainingDomainCoupling: Both backend generate methods invoke PrimeStudyPrompt.normalizeForGeneration. It allows exactly one user message and routes screening severity prompts through PrimeSeatKit to append Clinical meaning:. PrimeStudyWire also applies study framing. These are PMHNP-specific conventions within otherwise reusable loading/generation code.
routing.nativeEngineReuse: NativeTinyDecoder.forward(tokenIds:positionOffset:) is shared by explicitly separate PMHNP, Latin and compositional profiles. NativeLabCheckpoint.loadWeights loads the selected checkpoint. PMHNP is one corpus/tokenizer/profile, not the definition of the neural engine.
routing.appSpecificVerification: PrimeChatModelEndpoint.disposeModelDraft may substitute reference text after generation and marks that channel modelHybridGold; reply also has a fixed social-response branch. Use raw model helpers for the cross-domain comparison, retaining model output separately from deterministic answers.
routing.practicalNextBoundary: Keep model loading, tokenization and raw generation reusable. Make study framing and PMHNP verification explicit app adapters. Attach corpus/export registries to model experiments without changing existing tokenizers or claiming the source catalog has trained the model.
